lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Observed high-intensity circular pixel clusters are organized into a rectilinear grid comprising approximately seven vertical columns and five horizontal rows. The centroids are positioned at regular spatial intervals along the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Prominent vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect with the horizontal carinae. High-luminance circular blobs are centered at these intersections, functioning as primary grid nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three primary horizontal ridges are visible, defined by a distinct pixel intensity gradient with high luminance on the dorsal side and dark shadow on the ventral side, tracking the longitudinal axis of the flank.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin surface contains multiple small, discrete high-luminance blobs. These are non-uniformly distributed and significantly smaller in area than the flank blobs, appearing most concentrated towards the fin's base.
